reason: The plugin is primarily a browser-side diagnostics helper for DeepSeek Harness: it checks whether specific web APIs are available in the client environment and reports findings as console JSON, which is aimed at validating DOM/pixel rendering feasibility rather than modifying data or external services.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件，用于检测浏览器运行时的文档与绘图相关能力（如 document、canvas、MutationObserver、Image）并输出 JSON 报告，辅助判断 DOM 像素方案的可行性。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness client plugin that checks browser runtime capabilities such as document, canvas, MutationObserver, and Image, then outputs a JSON report to help validate whether DOM/pixel-based plugin approaches are feasible.

capabilities: Detects availability of selected browser APIs in runtime.
Performs client-side DOM-related checks for document/canvas/MutationObserver/Image capabilities.
Outputs a capability report to the browser console.
Counts SVG icon-related page indicators for feasibility diagnostics.

reasons.code: README states runtime checks cover document, canvas, MutationObserver, and Image capabilities.
Manifest/package configuration marks the plugin as client-only on the web platform.
Plugin installation model is profile-based web bundle injection, indicating client-side execution context.
